# Brepia Viewer

> Brepia Viewer is a free, open-source, browser-based OpenSCAD editor, model gallery, and 3D viewer.

The official website is https://viewer.notydesign.se/ and the source is available at https://github.com/weaf/brepia_viewer.

## Useful pages

- [Open Brepia Viewer](https://viewer.notydesign.se/): Browse OpenSCAD models, edit .scad projects, preview geometry, and export STL.
- [About Brepia Viewer](https://viewer.notydesign.se/about/): Features, how the viewer works, common questions, and local storage information.
- [Source code](https://github.com/weaf/brepia_viewer): Public GPL-3.0 project and documentation.
- [Privacy policy](https://viewer.notydesign.se/privacy-policy/): Privacy information.

## Important details

- OpenSCAD previews are rendered using WebAssembly in the visitor browser.
- The CodeMirror 6 editor supports syntax highlighting, autocomplete, search, replace, and code snippets.
- Imported OpenSCAD projects and edits are saved in browser IndexedDB on the same device and origin, not synced through a Brepia account.
- Built-in model catalogs and source files may be fetched from public GitHub repositories.
- STL is an available export format; STEP is not supported by Brepia Viewer.
